simple.meaning: גָּרַר (gârar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to drag off roughly ; by implication, to bring up the cud (i.e. ruminate); by analogy, to saw.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 5 times in Leviticus, 1 Kings, Proverbs, Jeremiah, Habakkuk, beginning at Leviticus 11:7. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּרַר (H1641) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גָּרַר (gârar) / H1641 is traced through Leviticus 11:7, 1 Kings 7:9, Proverbs 21:7, Jeremiah 30:23 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.

timeline.evidenceText: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.
All these were of costly stones, even of cut stone, according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.
The violence of the wicked will drive them away,
Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out,
He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net, and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

definitions.full: H1641. garar [ גָּרַר ] verb drag, drag away (Late Hebrew id. , Arabic Aramaic גְּרַר , ; Assyrian garâru , run , Zim BP 102 ; etc.) — Qal Imperfect suffix יְנֹרֵהוּ Hab 1:15 , יְגוֺרֵם Prov 21:7 — drag away , fishes in net, figurative Hab 1:15 (Chaldeans, their opponents); violence, the wicked Prov 21:7 . Niph`al (read Qal ? Samaritan יָגוֺר compare Di) Imperfect יִגָּ֑ר Lev 11:7 with accusative of congnate meaning with verb לֹאיִֿגָּ֑ר גֵּרָה = (the) cud he cheweth not , compare also Deut 14:8 ᵐ5 ⅏ (Di). Po`al Participle (denominative; so Late Hebrew Qal & Niph`al) בַּמְּגֵרָה מִגֹרָרוֺת 1Kin 7:9 sawn with the saw . Hithpo`el מִתְגּוֺרֵ֑ר סַעַר Jer 36:23 a (sweeping) roaring whirlwind (|| 23:19 has מִתְחוֺלֵל ). On יִתְגּוֺרָרוּ Hosea 7:14 , see I. גדד גור, .
